hub.title: Learn to code <brand>with</brand> AI — not instead of it.
hub.body: Honest, practical guides on staying a strong developer while you build with AI: how to learn from generated code, review it, remember what you learn, and where to point your skills next. Free to read — and paired with the Covate tool that quizzes you on your own code so the learning actually sticks.
hub.englishOnly: These guides are currently published in English only.

habit.title: The habit behind the guides
habit.body: Every guide here points at the same idea: understanding is a habit, not a one-off. Covate turns that habit into a tool. It’s an open-source MCP server that rides along with Claude, Cursor or Copilot, watches what actually changes in your codebase, and quizzes you on it — blocking further generation until you can explain what you just shipped. Sign in with GitHub and every session syncs into a learning ledger: each quiz you took, your running accuracy, and the topics you answer worst. Both halves are free — there is nothing to buy.
habit.install: or install the free, open-source MCP now
